W "MyApple Magazyn" znajdziecie recenzje różnego rodzaju urządzeń, oprogramowania, relacje z imprez branżowych, a także poradniki i felietony dotyczące cyfrowego i mobilnego stylu życia.

---

MyApple Magazyn is a biweekly Polish-language publication for Apple fans and anyone interested in new technologies. It’s created by a team of popular journalists and bloggers from Poland and the USA.

Each issue features hardware and software reviews, news, and highlights of the latest in tech, as well as tutorials and editorials sure to keep readers up to date on all aspects of Apple technology and the mobile lifestyle.
